interfaces.name: mapping
interfaces.constraints: Plain dict only, with nonblank string keys. Extra fields are permitted and ignored. interfaces.name: fields
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty plain list or tuple of unique nonblank string field names, all present in the mapping. Preserve supplied order and exact names without trimming. Reject missing, duplicate, unordered or invalid field names and container subclasses. No field order or application schema is inferred.
